title: 주의·이슈 및 업무처리 지침 웹 전용 공동 저장 계약
businessIdentityUse: This feature does not read, derive, group, or mutate ERP business identities. Country, flower, farm, and stage values are arbitrary web-only text metadata, not ERP keys.

legacyHandoffs.sourceMode: read-only projection; no copy, migration, normalization, or write
legacyHandoffs.emptySource: Revision 0 with an empty list remains empty; no seed or migrated-content claim is created.

categoryMeaning.SEASON: A user-selected guidance category only; the server does not infer the current season from dates or ERP weeks and does not auto-activate entries.

api.mutate: POST /api/operations-knowledge with expectedRevision and CREATE_ITEM, UPDATE_ITEM, or ADD_COMMENT
api.upload: POST /api/operations-knowledge/attachments multipart with expectedRevision, itemId, and one file
api.directStoreBypass: pages/api/import/tools/state.js rejects knowledge.guidance for both GET and PUT
api.delete: not supported; UPDATE_ITEM to RETIRED is the only retirement path

security.authentication: withAuth plus accountActive !== false for every endpoint
security.authorization: all existing active authenticated accounts have the same read/write scope
security.sameOrigin: all POST and upload requests require an exact Origin match to normalized forwarded protocol/host and reject Sec-Fetch-Site cross-site
security.actor: JWT actor and server time only; client actor/id/audit fields are rejected. UPDATE_ITEM audit changedFields contains allowlisted field paths, not duplicated before/after body text.
security.attachments: private runtime storage with UUID server filename; record-linked ID lookup only; no client paths or public URLs; MIME, extension, magic bytes, and Office ZIP structure are validated
security.proxyAllowance: 12 MiB only for the exact /api/operations-knowledge/attachments route; application validation remains 10 MiB

actions.name: CREATE_OR_UPDATE_GUIDANCE
actions.runtimeWrite: knowledge.guidance versioned JSON and server audit only

actions.name: ADD_COMMENT
actions.runtimeWrite: append-only comment and server audit in knowledge.guidance only

actions.name: ADD_OR_DOWNLOAD_ATTACHMENT
actions.runtimeWrite: private attachment file plus linked metadata and server audit only

actions.name: RETIRE_GUIDANCE
actions.runtimeWrite: status becomes RETIRED; item, comments, attachments, and audit remain readable

preserves: checklist.handoffs original value and revision from new feature writes

crossYearFixture.description: The feature is web-only and has no OrderYear/OrderWeek lookup or write. Arbitrary season metadata must not be parsed as OrderWeek, and identical text across years stays ordinary tags rather than an ERP join key.

dnspyEvidence.source: The guidance board is a Nenovaweb-only runtime JSON/file feature. No nenova.exe method or MSSQL writer is invoked; all ERP ledgers are preserve.
methods: Versioned runtime file CAS and private attachment storage only

acceptance: Unauthenticated and inactive accounts are rejected; every active account can read and write.
Stale expectedRevision returns 409 without changing the current record.
Client-supplied actor, timestamp, UUID, attachment path, or audit fields never become persisted values.
Legacy handoffs remain byte-for-byte and revision stable and are never counted as CURRENT.
No permanent delete API or UI exists; retired items remain readable with comments, attachments, and audit.
Attachment MIME/extension/signature and Office ZIP structure, size, auth, linked-ID lookup, path traversal, cleanup-on-CAS-failure, and response headers are tested.
The standard and popup shells pass the UI layout contract and the 1920x1080 browser smoke has no clipping, overlap, sticky obstruction, or modal escape.
No source file imports the MSSQL query or transaction layer for this feature.
